comment: Inputs a heavy test file reads that the commit alone doesn't determine, declared so its stored results can serve as an A/B control (STEW-3 R2-1). The tier observes every module a file's processes load and every file they read; anything not tracked at the commit, compiled from it, produced by the file itself, in node_modules (the lockfile) or in the build cache must be declared here, or the file's rows are complete gate evidence but never a control. `generated`: repository paths (prefixes) a file reads that a build or an earlier run produced; `external`: absolute path prefixes outside the repository; both are hashed as the run found them. `programs`: non-node programs it starts, which report nothing; `workers`: it starts worker threads, which preloads don't reach. Each entry says why that is a complete account.

regions-bake.heavy.test.ts.why: The bake bundles src/render/biomes/bake.ts with esbuild (its version is in the lockfile) and hashes every bundled source, the script and the toolchain into its key; public/terrain and the shared store are that key's cached output, restored only on an exact match, and --verify then rebakes in memory and compares with the live recipe. Its workers run the esbuild bundle of those same sources.
